name: @pilihpendidikan/jobs-scraper
description: Cloud scraper of the Job Tracker (job-tracker-spec/24): a Worker fronting a Cloudflare Container that runs the Python pilih-scraper service over the pilih-jobs Scrapling engine.

scripts.dev:python: sh ../../scripts/require-uv.sh && uv run --project python pilih-scraper serve --port 8791
scripts.build: bun run cf-typegen && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist --containers-rollout=none
scripts.lint: biome check . && sh ../../scripts/require-uv.sh && cd python && uv run ruff check src tests && uv run ruff format --check src tests
scripts.typecheck: bun run cf-typegen && tsc --noEmit && sh ../../scripts/require-uv.sh && cd python && uv run pyright
scripts.test: bun test && sh ../../scripts/require-uv.sh && cd python && uv run pytest -m "not live"
scripts.audit: sh ../../scripts/require-uv.sh && cd python && uv export --frozen --format requirements-txt --no-emit-project --all-groups --quiet | uv run --frozen pip-audit --strict --disable-pip --progress-spinner off -r /dev/stdin
